== Explanation ==
It was founded in {{ill|Ninna|de|Ninna|fa|نیننا|fr|Ère Ninna|hr|Ninna|ia|Ninna|id|Ninna|ja|仁和|ko|닌나|ru|Нинна (нэнго)|sh|Ninna|simple|Ninna|sr|Нина (ера)|th|นินนะ|tr|Ninna|uk|Нінна (ненґо)|zh|仁和 (日本)|zh_yue|仁和 (年號)|qid=Q1346317}} 2 (886), and the current main sanctuary is built in Kasuga-zukuri style.

The main deities are {{ill|Ōkuninushi|ca|Ōkuninushi|es|Ōkuninushi|fa|اوکونینوشی|fr|Ōkuninushi|hu|Ókuninusi|id|Ookuninushi|it|Ōkuninushi|ja|大国主|ko|오오쿠니누시|mni|ꯑꯣꯀꯨꯅꯤꯅꯨꯁꯤ|pl|Ōkuninushi|pt|Ookuninushi|ru|Окунинуси|simple|Ōkuninushi|sr|Okuninuši|sv|Ōkuninushi|tr|Ōkuninushi|uk|Окунінуші|vi|Ōkuninushi|zh|大國主|qid=Q276944|lt=Ōnamuchi-no-Mikoto}} and {{ill|Sukunabikona|ca|Sukunabikona|fr|Sukunabikona|it|Sukuna-hikona|ja|スクナビコナ|ko|스쿠나비코나|mni|ꯁꯨꯀꯨꯅꯕꯤꯀꯣꯅ|pl|Sukunabikona|pt|Sukunahikona|simple|Sukunabikona|sv|Suku-Na-Bikona|zh|少彥名|qid=Q3275687|lt=Sukunahikona-no-Mikoto}}. Since the {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} period, two Hachimangū shrines, two Itsukushima shrines, Ōtoshi Shrine, Kareki Shrine, and others formerly in the village have been merged and enshrined in the main sanctuary.

As precinct shrines, there is Tenmangū on the left (formerly Tarumi Hachimangū, but after merger with Kami-Shizuma Hachimangū and transfer to the main sanctuary, it now enshrines the Tenjin deity that had stood before the waterfall); on the right is Tōshōgū (because it was former {{ill|Tenryō|de|Tenryō|fa|تنریو|fr|Tenryō|ja|天領|ko|천령|wuu|天領|zh|天领|qid=Q1685411}}, it enshrines {{ill|Tokugawa The {{ill|Reisai|fr|Festival Reisai|ja|例祭|simple|Reisai|qid=Q11385469}} is April 15 (until the Meiji period, it was on the 15th days of the 3rd and 9th lunar months).

At the time of foundation, the shrine was enshrined inside {{ill|Shizu no Iwaya|ja|静之窟|qid=Q11662872}}, associated with the Man'yōshū, in the nearby Uozu settlement. After damage from high waves, it once moved outside the cave, then a heavy rain in June {{ill|1674|ab|1674|af|1674|als|1674|am|1674 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1674|ar|1674|ary|1674|arz|1674|ast|1674|avk|1674|az|1674|azb|۱۶۷۴ (میلادی)|ban|1674|bcl|1674|be|1674|be_x_old|1674|bg|1674|bn|১৬৭৪|bpy|মারি ১৬৭৪|br|1674|bs|1674.|ca|1674|cdo|1674 nièng|ceb|1674|ckb|١٦٧٤|co|1674|crh|1674|cs|1674|cv|1674|cy|1674|da|1674|de|1674|diq|1674|el|1674|eml|1674|eo|1674|es|1674|et|1674|eu|1674|fa|۱۶۷۴ (میلادی)|fi|1674|fo|1674|fr|1674|frp|1674|frr|1674|fur|1674|fy|1674|ga|1674|gan|1674年|gcr|1674|gd|1674|gl|1674|gv|1674|he|1674|hi|१६७४|hr|1674.|hsb|1674|ht|1674 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1674|hy|1674|hyw|1674 թուական|ia|1674|id|1674|ilo|1674|io|1674|is|1674|it|1674|ja|1674年|jv|1674|ka|1674|kaa|1674|kk|1674 жыл|ko|1674년|krc|1674 джыл|la|1674|lb|1674|lij|1674|lmo|1674|lt|1674 m.|lv|1674. gads|mai|१६७४|map_bms|1674|mdf|1674|mg|1674|mhr|1674|mi|1674|mk|1674|mr|इ.स. १६७४|mrj|1674 и|ms|1674|my|၁၆၇၄|mzn|۱۶۷۴|nah|1674|nap|1674|nds|1674|new|सन् १६७४|nl|1674|nn|1674|no|1674|nrm|1674|nso|1674|oc|1674|olo|1674|or|୧୬୭୪|os|1674-æм аз|pl|1674|pnb|1674|pt|1674|qu|1674|ro|1674|ru|1674 год|rue|1674|sa|१६७४|sah|1674|scn|1674|sd|1674ع|se|1674|sh|1674.|shn|1674|simple|1674|sk|1674|sl|1674|smn|1674|sq|1674|sr|1674|su|1674|sv|1674|sw|1674|szl|1674|ta|1674|te|1674|tg|Соли 1674|th|พ.ศ. 2217|tk|1674|tl|1674|tly|1674|tr|1674|tt|1674 ел|uk|1674|ur|1674ء|uz|1674|vec|1674|vi|1674|vls|1674|wa|1674|war|1674|wuu|1674年|xmf|1674|yi|1674|zh|1674年|zh_min_nan|1674 nî|zh_yue|1674年|qid=Q7620}} ({{ill|Enpō|fa|انپو|fr|Ère Enpō|ja|延宝|ko|엔포|ru|Эмпо|simple|Enpō|sr|Енпо|sv|Enpō|tr|Enpō|zh|延寶|qid=Q1145735}} 2) caused a debris-flow mountain tsunami that collapsed the shrine building, so it was moved to Mount Tarumi the following year.

The shrine preserves as many as 104 munafuda dating from 1650 onward. These plaques show that even in the {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Έντο|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|new|इदो काल|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963}}, when commoners were not permitted {{ill|myoujitaitou|ja|苗字帯刀|qid=Q11616116|lt=surnames and sword-bearing}}, residents used {{ill|myōji|ja|名字|ko|명자|qid=Q69634220|lt=surnames}} in shrine activities and lived actively.
